_help.about: The four seasons (design reconciliation Session 2 section F): winter, spring, summer, autumn over the 365-day year (data/sky/day_cycle.json), with a generous transition between each pair. The southern hemisphere runs half a year behind. Seasons read and the weather sim reads them; plants don't respond yet.
_help.calendar: lag_days: how long after each solstice/equinox the season's middle falls (the ground and sea take time to warm and cool). transition_days: the length of each change of season (winter to spring and so on), centred on the boundary; the rest of each ~91-day season is settled.
_help.temperature: The seasonal swing added to the weather's temperature: winter is minus amplitude, summer plus, spring and autumn zero, ramping through the transitions. amplitude_c_equator / amplitude_c_pole: the swing at the equator and at the poles (degrees C), in between by latitude^curve; over open water the swing is ocean_damping times smaller (the sea moderates it).
_help.moisture: How wet each season is, as a multiplier on evaporation (so on cloud and rain): by climate band. Tropical (up to tropical_deg): the wet season is summer, when the sun stands overhead; temperate (from temperate_deg to polar_deg): a little wetter in winter; polar (past polar_deg): wetter in summer. Between bands they blend.
_help.autumn_colour: [NOT WIRED YET — design §AI.1 revised] How deciduous foliage turns. The colour change is NOT the 20-day transition on/off: it runs over days_total game-days (about 6 weeks, like a real autumn), starting lead_days BEFORE the autumn transition begins (cool nights start it, on the temperature curve), and goes through the stages in order as a gradient — green → yellow-green → the species' tint.autumn → a duller browner version of it → drop. Each stage lasts its share of days_total. Per tree: a ±jitter_days offset (seeded per tree) so a hillside turns over weeks, not overnight; per cluster: the top and outer clusters lead the inner/lower ones by cluster_lead_days (real trees turn from the outside in). Spring is the mirror: bare → bud (tint val 0.6, pale) → young leaf (lighter, yellower green) → full green over spring_days. Latitude/altitude shift the start through the temperature curve automatically.
